title: Hostel Facilities
content: SRMIST provides excellent residential facilities for both male and female students with separate hostel blocks. Hostels offer a choice of AC and Non-AC rooms with single, double, triple, and four-sharing options. Standard facilities include study tables, wardrobes, 24/7 high-speed Wi-Fi, continuous electricity supply with backup generators, solar hot water systems, and common recreation rooms with TVs and indoor games. Each hostel block has dedicated laundry facilities, a gym, and round-the-clock security with CCTV monitoring. The mess services serve a variety of nutritious foods, including North Indian, South Indian, and Continental cuisines. Strict guidelines are in place regarding hostel timings, and students must obtain permission from the warden (via the online gate pass system) for outing or leave.
